title: A generator criterion for annihilating an exterior tensor quotient kernel
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and S=(K→B→C) a short exact sequence of module sheaves with maps f,g. Let A,D be any module sheaves, r,s natural numbers, T=(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s B), Q=(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s C), using [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Let q:T→Q take each tensor of pure wedges a,c to a⊗g(c). If ψ:T→D sends every tensor of pure wedges a,c with c_j=f(d), for any j and any section d of K on the same open, to zero, then the kernel inclusion of q followed by ψ is zero.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: exterior-power universal properties and independence of quotient lifts

proof.text: If s=0, identify both zeroth exterior powers with the structure sheaf by exists_exteriorPower_zero_iso_wedge. Exterior tensor lift extensionality identifies q with the tensor of the identity and the resulting isomorphism. Thus q is mono and its kernel inclusion is zero. This is the existing official proof, with exteriorPower and wedge throughout.

For s≠0, a section of kernel(q) maps to a section t with q(t)=0. The official local-span theorem expresses its restriction near each point as a member of the span of pure wedge tensors having an entry f(d). The assumed relation vanishing puts all generators, hence their span, in ker(ψ). Naturality and sheaf section extensionality imply ψ(t)=0. Extensionality proves kernel.ι q ≫ ψ=0.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorTensor_kernel_eq_zero_of_relations {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (A D : X.Modules) (r s : ℕ)
    (q : exteriorPower A r ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₂ s ⟶
      exteriorPower A r ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ s)
    (ψ : exteriorPower A r ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₂ s ⟶ D)
    (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin s → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      q.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (wedge (M := A) (r := r) (U := U) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := s) (U := U) c)) =
        tmulSection (M := exteriorPower A r) (N := exteriorPower S.X₃ s)
          (wedge (M := A) (r := r) (U := U) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₃) (r := s) (U := U) (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i))))
    (hzero : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin s → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)) (j : Fin s) (d : S.X₁.val.obj (op U)),
      c j = S.f.val.app (op U) d →
      ψ.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (wedge (M := A) (r := r) (U := U) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := s) (U := U) c)) = 0) :
    kernel.ι q ≫ ψ = 0
